name: Golden Designs Nora 2-Person Full Spectrum Hybrid Sauna in Red Cedar Wood Interior
description: Nora PureTech 2-Person Full Spectrum Hybrid Sauna in Red Cedar Wood Interior The Golden Designs Nora PureTech 2-Person Full Spectrum Hybrid Sauna in Red Cedar Wood offers a luxurious and versatile wellness retreat, blending advanced technology with natural elegance. Designed for durability, its all-weather exterior ensures resilience against various environmental conditions, while the interior is crafted from premium Canadian Red Cedar, known for its rich aroma, natural antibacterial properties, and superior insulation. The sauna features an oversized interior Chromotherapy lighting system, providing a spectrum of therapeutic colors to enhance relaxation and overall well-being. Adding to the comfort, the interior includes a thoughtfully designed backrest with accent lighting, creating a soothing and visually appealing atmosphere. This combination of robust construction, natural materials, and innovative features makes the Golden Designs Nora PureTech sauna a sophisticated addition to any home, offering an immersive and rejuvenating sauna experience. Features Delivery: This item will be delivered curbside only on a pallet by a freight carrier. Location: Outdoor Use Specifications Specification Details Capacity 2 person Electrical Service 240V / 30AMP (Stove & Full Spectrum) (Please consult a certified electrician.)
